title: 第7章 画风有些不大对第8章 离开县城
content_zh:
识海空间。
李青山看着眼前悬浮的虚影，有些摸不着头脑。
这是张三侄子的灵魂？
说是灵魂，也不准确。
因为李青山眼前的虚影，由一条条不同颜色的线条构成，不像个人，反而像是画家勾勒的简笔画。
这些组成虚影的线条，一共有灰色、白色、金色，三种颜色。
其中大部分线条，是灰色，组成了虚影的轮廓。
极少的白色线条，分散在这虚影的头部。
而金色线条，则像是李青山前世看过的经脉图片，形成了一个相对完整的金色脉络，贯穿了虚影的头和尾，就好像是这虚影的经脉血管网络。
不过这个金色大网中，只有部分金色线条是完全闭环连接。
其余部分，全都有残缺、断开。
甚至还有些区域，直接是空白。
这些金色线条之间，也有很大的不同。
其中好似枝干一样，完整的‘大’字型网络，在散发着淡淡的金色光辉。
其余残缺、断开的金色线条，则全部呈现暗金色，就像是一条条死掉的尸体。
李青山不用想都能猜到，那完整连接的‘大’字型金色网络，就是张三侄子的自愈天赋体现。
“这些金色线条网络，总不可能都是张三侄子隐藏的天赋吧？”
李青山忍不住咋舌。
如果是真的，说明自愈天赋，只是张三侄子兑现的一小部分天赋。
这一小部分，便如此逆天。

要是这金色线条网络完整，张三侄子岂不是能直接化身祖国人？
带着疑惑。
李青山和之前融合百吨王时一样，对着眼前的虚影伸出手掌。
这次却不是融合，而是反馈了大量信息过来。
...
接收完信息，李青山再次看向眼前的线条虚影。
和他前面猜测的一样。
这线条构成的虚影，便是张三侄子蕴含的所有天赋。
李青山已经知晓要如何才能读取、融合这些天赋。
他将注意力，分别放到那些灰白金的线条上面，心中默念，开始读取这些线条所代表的天赋。
灰色线条最为简单。
它们都是些肌肉、骨骼等身体上的天赋。
如果选择这些天赋融合，天赋叠加之下，李青山便能长得更加高大、强壮。
白色线条最少，是灵魂上面的天赋。
张三侄子本身不是什么出彩的人，这些白色线条，都是些精神韧性...
估计是抗压和自我内耗锻炼出来的天赋碎片。
至于金色线条...
李青山读取完天赋信息后，怀疑自己是不是看错了。
他又读取了几遍，陷入了沉默。
画风有些不大对。

这些金色线条天赋，统称为黄巾力士血脉。
...
content_en:
Consciousness sea space.
Li Qingshan looked at the floating shadow in front of him, a little confused.
Is this the soul of Zhang San’s nephew?
It's not accurate to say it's the soul.
Because the shadow in front of Li Qingshan is composed of lines of different colors. It does not look like a person, but like a simple drawing drawn by an artist.
These lines that make up the shadows come in three colors: gray, white, and gold.
Most of the lines are gray and form the outline of the shadow.
Very few white lines are scattered on the head of this phantom.
The golden lines are like the pictures of meridians that Li Qingshan had seen in his previous life, forming a relatively complete golden vein that runs through the head and tail of the shadow, just like the meridians and blood vessels network of the shadow.
However, in this golden network, only some of the golden lines are completely closed-loop connected.
The remaining parts are all incomplete and disconnected.
There are even some areas that are directly blank.
There is also a big difference between these golden lines.
Like branches, a complete network of "big" characters exudes a faint golden light.
The rest of the incomplete and broken golden lines were all dark gold, like dead corpses.
Li Qingshan could guess without even thinking that the fully connected 'big' golden network was the embodiment of Zhang San's nephew's self-healing talent.
“It’s impossible for these golden lines network to be Zhang San’s nephew’s hidden talent, right?”
Li Qingshan couldn't help but be speechless.
If it is true, it means that the self-healing talent is only a small part of Zhang San's nephew's talent.
This small part is so outrageous.
If this golden line network were complete, wouldn't Zhang San's nephew be able to directly transform into a citizen of the motherland?
With doubts.
Li Qingshan extended his palm to the phantom in front of him just like when he fused with the Hundred Ton King before.
This time it was not a fusion, but a large amount of information fed back.
...
After receiving the message, Li Qingshan looked at the lines in front of him again.
It was the same as what he had guessed before.
The shadow formed by these lines is all the talent contained in Zhang San’s nephew.
Li Qingshan already knows how to read and integrate these talents.
He focused his attention on the gray-white gold lines, and silently thought in his mind, he began to read the talents represented by these lines.
Gray lines are the simplest.
They are all physical gifts such as muscles and bones.
If you choose to fuse these talents, Li Qingshan will be able to grow taller and stronger with the superposition of talents.
The white lines are the least, which is the talent of the soul.
Nephew Zhang San is not an outstanding person. These white lines are all about mental toughness...
It is probably the fragments of talent that are tempered by stress resistance and self-inflicted internal friction.
As for the golden lines...
After Li Qingshan read the talent information, he wondered if he had read it wrong.
He read it a few more times and fell into silence.
There's something wrong with the style of painting.
These golden line talents are collectively called the bloodline of the Yellow Turban Warriors.
...
